# Saltmarrow Chronology

The town's timeline from 1914 to 1929, fictional events in Saltmarrow set against the real background I read about. Real events are background only: they appear in the right-hand column as what the wider world was doing, never as something that happened in Saltmarrow. The chapter order of the third draft is in [[third-draft-chapter-map]]; the spreadsheet with month-level detail is [[saltmarrow-timeline-spreadsheet]].

| Year | Saltmarrow (fiction) | Background (real, general) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1914-1918 | 61 men of the town killed; Walter Pascoe's son in 1916; Kit Harker gassed 1918 | The war; see [[interwar-period]] and [[shell-shock]] |
| 1918-1919 | Influenza in the town in the winter; Tobias home in 1919 | The 1918 influenza pandemic ([[spanish-flu]]) |
| 1921 | Edmund Leal, vicar, dies; Constance crosses to the chapel | |
| 1922 | War memorial unveiled on the green by St Anne's | Memorials raised everywhere ([[war-memorial]]) |
| 1924 | March: Nell leaves the yards. April: Tobias coxswain, Nell at the telegraph office. May: Constance takes the choir | Broadcasting spreading ([[history-of-radio]]) |
| 1925 | June: Nell joins the choir | |
| 1926 | Institute buys a wireless set; July chapel social | |
| 1927 | Choir sings in four parts by April. November: storm; the *Providence* lost with five crew. December: memorial | |
| 1928 | January: inquiry. Fund for the families. September: motor lifeboat arrives | Motor lifeboats replacing pulling boats ([[lifeboat-rescue]]) |
| 1929 | Telegraph office cut back; herring prices falling; October: news of the crash | The crash of 1929 as background only; see [[how-would-saltmarrow-hear-of-the-wall-street-crash]] |

## Rules

- Nothing in the right-hand column is ever said to happen in Saltmarrow.
- When the draft and this table disagree, check the [[character-bible]] and then fix whichever is wrong, with a line in the [[saltmarrow-anachronism-log]] if it was a period error.
